**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent) — fallback insert proposed.**

- Swept the whole document: the only occurrence of "insurance" is a Licensee-side cost pass-through in § II (p0051); Article XXIV General Provisions (p0145–p0159) has no coverage covenant, and targeted searches for coverage/certificate language returned nothing.
- Since Licensor hosts the Platform and processes our trade data, no insurance at all is walk-away territory, so an insert is warranted.
- Target level: **fallback** — one new paragraph (l) INSURANCE requiring E&O of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of not less than USD 2,000,000, mapping both fallback elements. No preferred-only extras (CGL, workers' compensation, certificates, at-own-expense, survival tail) were volunteered, keeping the change at the checklist ceiling.
